fields.name: divergence
fields.label: 3D Strength
fields.tooltip: Strength of the 3D effect. 0-2 is a reasonable range for most content; higher values push more depth but can increase artifacts near edges.

fields.name: method
fields.label: Method
fields.tooltip: The stereo-generation algorithm used to synthesize the second eye's view from the depth map. row_flow_v3 is the modern default for most content.

fields.name: splat_blend_temperature
fields.label: Splat Blend Temperature
fields.tooltip: Only used by Method=forward_splat_fill: how sharply the depth-weighted blend favors the nearer of two colliding pixels. Higher = sharper cutoff. Default (50.0) matches the method's original behavior.

fields.name: synthetic_view
fields.label: Synthetic View
fields.tooltip: Which side generates the synthesized view. 'both' warps both eyes from the source; 'right'/'left' keeps the original image as one eye and only synthesizes the other.

fields.name: convergence_mode
fields.label: Convergence Mode
fields.tooltip: How the convergence plane (screen-distance point) is chosen. 'constant' uses the Convergence Plane value directly; sod_v1/face_detect track it automatically per frame.

fields.name: convergence
fields.label: Convergence Plane
fields.tooltip: Normalized depth position (0-1) that appears at screen distance, with nothing feeling like it's popping out or sinking in at that point.

fields.name: convergence_smoothing
fields.label: Convergence Smoothing
fields.tooltip: EMA decay for the auto convergence modes (sod_v1/face_detect). Higher = smoother but slower to react; 0 = no smoothing.

fields.name: ipd_offset
fields.label: Your Own Size
fields.tooltip: IPD offset as a width-scale percent. 0-10 is a reasonable value for Full SBS output.

fields.name: stereo_width
fields.label: Stereo Processing Width
fields.tooltip: Input width for row_flow_v3/row_flow_v2. Leave blank for the model's default.

fields.name: depth_model
fields.label: Depth Model
fields.tooltip: Which neural network estimates depth from the source image. Different models trade off speed, video-temporal stability, and fine detail.

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Depth Resolution
fields.tooltip: Input resolution (short side) fed to the depth model. Leave blank for the model's default.

fields.name: limit_resolution
fields.label: Limit to source
fields.tooltip: If the source resolution is lower than Depth Resolution, cap the depth resolution at the source's own resolution instead of upscaling first.

fields.name: foreground_scale
fields.label: Foreground Scale
fields.tooltip: Foreground scaling level, -3.0 to 3.0. 0 is disabled.

fields.name: edge_dilation
fields.label: Edge Fix
fields.tooltip: Loop count of edge dilation, as "<x> <y>" or a single shared value. Space-separated.

fields.name: depth_aa
fields.label: Depth Anti-aliasing
fields.tooltip: Applies depth antialiasing. Ignored for models that don't support it.

fields.name: depth_refine
fields.label: Depth Detail Refinement
fields.tooltip: Cleans up each depth frame's own internal noise with edge-preserving smoothing, within that single frame (a different axis from EMA, which smooths ACROSS frames).

fields.name: depth_refine_strength
fields.label: Depth Refine Strength
fields.tooltip: How strong the Depth Detail Refinement pass is. 1.0 matches the feature's original fixed behavior.

fields.name: temporal_stabilize
fields.label: Object Stability
fields.tooltip: Approximates a video-aware model's frame-to-frame stability for a single-frame model, using optical flow to reduce object depth flickering EMA alone can't fix.

fields.name: temporal_stabilize_strength
fields.label: Object Stability Strength
fields.tooltip: How strongly to trust the motion-warped previous frame vs. the fresh per-frame depth (0-1). Tapers down automatically during fast motion.

fields.name: foreground_pop
fields.label: Foreground Pop
fields.tooltip: Pushes the nearest pixels even further toward the audience (0.0=off, 0.5=medium, 1.0=strong).

fields.name: foreground_divergence
fields.label: Foreground Divergence
fields.tooltip: A separate 3D Strength for the nearest ~15% of pixels only. Leave blank to use the same value as the rest of the scene.

fields.name: background_pop
fields.label: Background Pop
fields.tooltip: Pushes the farthest pixels even further from the audience (0.0=off, 0.5=medium, 1.0=strong).

fields.name: background_pop_coverage
fields.label: Background Pop Coverage %
fields.tooltip: How much of the scene Background Pop treats as "background" (0.0-1.0). Default 0.15 = farthest 15%.

fields.name: background_divergence
fields.label: Background Divergence
fields.tooltip: A separate 3D Strength for the farthest ~15% of pixels only. Leave blank to use the same value as the rest of the scene.

fields.name: edge_repair_strength
fields.label: Edge Repair
fields.tooltip: Final cleanup pass smoothing a thin band right around real depth edges to reduce hairline fringing. 0.0=off.

fields.name: sharpen
fields.label: Sharpen
fields.tooltip: Final edge-aware unsharp-mask pass on the rendered stereo output. Off by default.

fields.name: sharpen_strength
fields.label: Sharpen Strength
fields.tooltip: How strong the Sharpen pass is (0.0=no effect, 1.0=strongest).

fields.name: ema_normalize
fields.label: Flicker Reduction
fields.tooltip: Uses a moving min/max average to normalize video depth over time, reducing frame-to-frame flicker.

fields.name: ema_decay
fields.label: EMA Decay
fields.tooltip: Smoothing strength for Flicker Reduction (0-1). Larger = smoother.

fields.name: ema_buffer
fields.label: EMA Buffer
fields.tooltip: Frame buffer size for Flicker Reduction's moving average.

fields.name: ema_motion_adaptive
fields.label: Motion-Adaptive Smoothing
fields.tooltip: Automatically eases EMA Decay off during fast motion instead of one fixed strength for the whole clip. Never smooths more than EMA Decay itself, only less.

fields.name: scene_detect
fields.label: Scene Boundary Detection
fields.tooltip: Splits processing at real scene cuts (shot boundary detection); EMA and other running state resets at each cut.

fields.name: disable_scene_cache
fields.label: Disable Scene Boundary Cache
fields.tooltip: Disables the cache Scene Boundary Detection normally reuses on a re-run of the same file.

fields.name: scene_batch_auto_ema
fields.label: Auto EMA by Scene Length
fields.tooltip: Automatically picks EMA Decay/Buffer per scene based on that scene's own length, using a built-in table. Requires Scene Boundary Detection (or Automated Scene Batch, on the Video Filter tab).

fields.name: scene_batch_auto_ema_model
fields.label: Auto EMA Model
fields.tooltip: Which built-in EMA-by-duration table to use, matched to the Depth Model in use.

fields.name: preserve_screen_border
fields.label: Preserve Screen Border
fields.tooltip: Forces screen-border parallax to zero.

fields.name: stereo_format
fields.label: Stereo Format
fields.tooltip: The output layout. Maps to several mutually-exclusive iw3 CLI flags under the hood (--half-sbs/--tb/--half-tb/--vr180/--cross-eyed/--rgbd/--half-rgbd/--anaglyph) -- handled specially in worker.py, not a direct 1:1 CLI arg.

fields.name: anaglyph_method
fields.label: Anaglyph Method
fields.tooltip: Which anaglyph color-filter recipe to use. Only meaningful when Stereo Format is Anaglyph.

fields.name: stereo_mode_tag
fields.label: Tag MKV as 3D
fields.tooltip: Tags the finished .mkv's video track with the Matroska StereoMode property so 3D-aware players/TVs auto-detect the 3D packing instead of the viewer picking it manually.

fields.name: depth_blend
fields.label: Dual-Pass Depth Blend
fields.tooltip: Blends depth from a second model into the primary Depth Model's output, favoring the second model in areas with dense fine detail (foliage, hair, close-up texture). Runs as three full passes over the clip; costs real extra time and disk space. Requires a single video file input.

fields.name: depth_blend_model
fields.label: Secondary Depth Model
fields.tooltip: The secondary depth model blended in by Dual-Pass Depth Blend.

fields.name: depth_blend_strength
fields.label: Blend Strength
fields.tooltip: How strongly to favor the secondary model in the selected region (0-1). 1.0 = fully trust it there.

fields.name: depth_blend_region
fields.label: Blend Region
fields.tooltip: What decides WHERE the secondary model gets blended in: 'detail' (dense fine visual detail), 'foreground' (nearest X% of the scene), or 'background' (farthest X%).

fields.name: depth_blend_region_percent
fields.label: Blend Region %
fields.tooltip: For Blend Region foreground/background: what percent of the scene (by depth) to blend the secondary model into.

fields.name: start_time
fields.label: Start Time
fields.tooltip: Start time offset for video, hh:mm:ss or mm:ss format.

fields.name: end_time
fields.label: End Time
fields.tooltip: End time offset for video, hh:mm:ss or mm:ss format.

fields.name: vf
fields.label: -vf (raw ffmpeg filter)
fields.tooltip: Raw ffmpeg -vf filter string, applied as-is. Advanced use.

fields.name: rotate_left
fields.label: Rotate Left
fields.tooltip: Rotate 90 degrees counterclockwise.

fields.name: rotate_right
fields.label: Rotate Right
fields.tooltip: Rotate 90 degrees clockwise.

fields.name: autocrop
fields.label: AutoCrop
fields.tooltip: Automatically removes black/flat-color bars. BLACK_TB/FLAT_TB: top and bottom only. BLACK/FLAT: all sides. Blank = off.

fields.name: pad
fields.label: Padding
fields.tooltip: Pad size = round(width * this) // 2. Leave blank for no padding.

fields.name: pad_mode
fields.label: Padding Mode
fields.tooltip: Which sides Padding is applied to.

fields.name: max_output_width
fields.label: Max Output Width
fields.tooltip: Limits output width, e.g. for cardboard players. Leave blank for no limit.

fields.name: max_output_height
fields.label: Max Output Height
fields.tooltip: Limits output height, e.g. for cardboard players. Leave blank for no limit.

fields.name: keep_aspect_ratio
fields.label: Keep Aspect Ratio
fields.tooltip: Keeps the source aspect ratio when Max Output Width/Height resize the output.

fields.name: preserve_dowi
fields.label: Preserve Dolby Vision
fields.tooltip: Preserves Dolby Vision RPU metadata in HEVC output (requires dovi_tool, bundled with this app).

fields.name: hdr_to_sdr
fields.label: HDR to SDR
fields.tooltip: Tone-maps a PQ/HLG HDR source down to SDR (10-bit retained) before conversion.

fields.name: auto_resume
fields.label: Auto Resume
fields.tooltip: Splits video into chunks and resumes from a checkpoint if the conversion is interrupted.

fields.name: resume_chunk_duration
fields.label: Resume Chunk Duration (sec)
fields.tooltip: Chunk duration in seconds for Auto Resume.

fields.name: denoise
fields.label: Denoise
fields.tooltip: Applies temporal denoising (hqdn3d, a one-time ffmpeg pre-pass) before depth estimation, to reduce film grain artifacts.

fields.name: preview
fields.label: Preview Mode
fields.tooltip: Generates a quick 1fps/256p preview of the first 60 seconds to check 3D settings before a full run.

fields.name: upgrade_pix_fmt
fields.label: Bit Depth Upgrade
fields.tooltip: Upgrades an 8-bit source to 10-bit or 12-bit output pixel format. Blank = no upgrade.

fields.name: metadata
fields.label: Add Metadata to Filename
fields.tooltip: Adds a metadata suffix to the output filename. The real --metadata flag takes an optional value ("filename"); this checkbox is the on/off case, handled specially in worker.py.

fields.name: scene_batch
fields.label: Automated Scene Batch
fields.tooltip: Fully automated whole-movie pipeline: removes letterbox bars once, detects scene cuts once, converts each scene independently, then joins the results back into one seamless video. Input must be a single video file.

fields.name: scene_batch_crop
fields.label: Scene Batch Crop
fields.tooltip: Explicit crop for Automated Scene Batch, as WxH or WxH:X:Y. If blank, letterbox bars are auto-detected once from the whole movie.

fields.name: scene_settings
fields.label: Scene Settings File
fields.tooltip: JSON file giving per-scene setting overrides for Automated Scene Batch.

fields.name: scene_batch_variant
fields.label: Scene Batch Variant
fields.tooltip: Optional name for this Automated Scene Batch run -- reuses already-done shared work from a prior run of the same movie, but writes its own output as <name>_<variant>.<ext> so trying different settings never overwrites an earlier attempt.

fields.name: hwaccel
fields.label: HWAccel
fields.tooltip: Hardware-accelerated video decode.

fields.name: disable_software_fallback
fields.label: Disable Software Fallback
fields.tooltip: Disables falling back to software (CPU) decoding if hardware decode fails partway through.

fields.name: video_format
fields.label: Video Format
fields.tooltip: Output video container format.

fields.name: video_codec
fields.label: Video Codec
fields.tooltip: Video codec to encode with. Availability depends on Video Format and this machine's hardware encoders.

fields.name: max_fps
fields.label: Max FPS
fields.tooltip: Output fps = min(source fps, this value).

fields.name: pix_fmt
fields.label: Pixel Format
fields.tooltip: Pixel format for video output.

fields.name: colorspace
fields.label: Colorspace
fields.tooltip: Video colorspace tag written to the output.

fields.name: crf
fields.label: CRF
fields.tooltip: Constant quality value. Smaller = higher quality/larger file.

fields.name: video_bitrate
fields.label: Bitrate
fields.tooltip: Bitrate option, only used by the libopenh264 codec.

fields.name: preset
fields.label: Preset
fields.tooltip: Encoder speed/quality preset.

fields.name: tune
fields.label: Tune
fields.tooltip: Encoder tuning(s), space or comma separated. Which values are valid depends on the chosen codec (this simplified picker does not filter the list by codec the way the desktop GUI does).

fields.name: profile_level
fields.label: Profile Level
fields.tooltip: H.264 profile level, e.g. 4.1. Advanced use.

fields.name: low_vram
fields.label: Low VRAM
fields.tooltip: Disables batch processing so each frame uses less GPU memory at a time. Slower, but avoids out-of-memory crashes/freezes on smaller GPUs or VRAM-heavy methods like forward_splat_fill.

fields.name: compile
fields.label: torch.compile
fields.tooltip: Compiles the depth/stereo models for faster inference. First run after a settings change is slower (compile time); needs the CUDA-context ordering this app already preserves (ADR-034/071/075) to combine safely with hardware decode.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Depth Batch Size
fields.tooltip: How many frames are processed together per depth-model pass. Ignored when Low VRAM is on.

fields.name: max_workers
fields.label: Worker Threads
fields.tooltip: Max inference worker threads for video processing. 0 = disabled.

fields.name: tta
fields.label: TTA
fields.tooltip: Uses flip augmentation on the depth model for slightly higher quality, at extra compute cost.

fields.name: cuda_stream
fields.label: Stream
fields.tooltip: Uses a separate CUDA stream per worker thread/device.

fields.name: pause_frees_vram
fields.label: Free GPU memory while paused
fields.tooltip: When Suspend/Resume is used, also moves every loaded model off the GPU and frees VRAM while paused, reloading on Resume. Off by default (models stay resident for an instant Resume). Has no effect with multiple GPUs selected.

fields.name: waifu2x_upscale
fields.label: Upscale with waifu2x after conversion
fields.tooltip: After conversion finishes, runs the output through waifu2x (a separate bundled AI upscaler) as one extra step, written to a separate '<name>_w2x<ext>' file.

fields.name: waifu2x_upscale_target
fields.label: Upscale Target
fields.tooltip: 'auto' uses waifu2x-upscale's plain whole-frame behavior. '4k'/'8k' use a stereo-aware path that upscales each eye of a packed 3D output independently.

fields.name: rife_interpolate
fields.label: Interpolate frames with RIFE after conversion
fields.tooltip: After conversion finishes, runs the finished packed stereo output through RIFE frame interpolation, raising the effective frame rate. Written to a separate '<name>_rife<ext>' file. Cannot be combined with Preserve Dolby Vision.

fields.name: rife_model
fields.label: RIFE Model
fields.tooltip: rife_425 is the recommended full-quality model; rife_425_lite is a lower-compute-cost variant.

fields.name: rife_multiplier
fields.label: RIFE Multiplier
fields.tooltip: Frame-rate multiplier: N=2 doubles the frame rate, N=3/4 triple/quadruple it. Mutually exclusive with RIFE Target FPS. Defaults to 2 if both are left blank.

fields.name: rife_target_fps
fields.label: RIFE Target FPS
fields.tooltip: Interpolates to this exact frame rate instead of a simple multiplier. Must be higher than the source's own frame rate. Mutually exclusive with RIFE Multiplier.
